lines.en: What is this number in the newspaper?
It says twenty thousand people live in our town.
lines.ko: 우리 동네에 이만 명이 산다고 해요.

lines.en: Twenty thousand! That's a big number.
Last year it was ten thousand. Half of that.
How much is this coat? Read the price.
lines.ko: 이 코트는 얼마예요? 가격을 읽어 봐요.

lines.en: It is thirty thousand. Can you read that?
Thirty thousand. I will remember it next time.
Yes! That is the right number, Grandma.
Next month I will read the numbers with no help.
lines.ko: 다음 달에는 도움 없이 숫자를 읽을 거예요.

lines.en: Great, Grandma. Numbers are fun.
Hello. Please take a number here.
Thank you. My number is twenty. Who is first?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 제 번호는 이십이에요. 누가 첫 번째예요?

lines.en: Number ten is first. Next is number twenty.
lines.ko: 십 번이 첫 번째예요. 다음이 이십 번이에요.

lines.en: How many people are before me?
Only one. It will take about ten minutes.
lines.ko: 한 사람뿐이에요. 십 분쯤 걸릴 거예요.

lines.en: Last week I waited half an hour.
I'm sorry. Today is not busy.
How many people are here today?
There are thirty people in total today.
I see. I will wait here. Thank you.
